harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired supervisor.py on node1. It now starts the requested jobs, waits for and reaps every child, appends each exit status, preserves prior results, and persists across reboot on the unchanged legacy platform.
actions_performed: Implemented Python 2.5-compatible child tracking and os.wait() reaping
Recorded even jobs as status 0 and odd jobs as status 3
Verified zero zombie processes after execution
Safely rebooted node1 and verified persistence and recovery

evidence.requirement: Supervisor starts the requested number of jobs and records correct statuses while preserving previous results
evidence.summary: Six- and eight-job runs added exactly the requested rows with the required 0/3 parity pattern. The original previous,0,0 record remains.

evidence.requirement: Every child is reaped and the supervisor waits for completion
evidence.summary: The implementation tracks child PIDs, waits for termination, decodes wait statuses, and leaves zero zombie processes.

evidence.requirement: Legacy operating system and kernel remain compatible and unchanged
evidence.summary: The repair compiles under Python 2.5.1; node1 remains Ubuntu 7.10 with kernel 2.6.22-14-generic.

Healthy baseline captured, reboot acknowledged, boot ID changed from b5553c42-02c0-4953-b8c2-15aa87917e30 to c7f70334-6932-4b29-820a-bd5c5266b272, and a post-restart eight-job run confirmed recovered code and data.
